apps.name: iSharpe Depot
apps.description: Installs and updates all of iSharpe's phone apps, including itself.
apps.releaseNotes: Clearer steps for installing the CRM and dashboard web apps.

apps.name: iSharpe FileSafe
apps.description: Your iSharpe FileSafe on your phone: see and open your computers' files, upload files, and back up your photos automatically.
apps.releaseNotes: First version: sign in with email and setup code, see and open your files, upload files, automatic photo backup.

apps.name: Next Appointment
apps.description: Your next CRM appointment as a line at the top of the phone, with a warning an hour before. Needs a key from CRM Settings.
apps.releaseNotes: Next Appointment is now in iSharpe Depot and signed with the same key as the other iSharpe apps. If you had it from the CRM's download button, uninstall that one first.

apps.name: Sharp
apps.description: A clean home screen: the apps you pick, then one A–Z list of everything with a letter strip to jump through it.
apps.releaseNotes: Fixes adding web apps (the iSharpe CRM, the dashboard): Chrome's Add to Home screen now works with Sharp. They show on the home screen and in the A-Z list; long-press then Remove shortcut takes one off.

apps.name: Weather Line
apps.description: Weather in one line: a home-screen widget with today's high, low and chance of rain, shaded for sunrise and sunset.
apps.releaseNotes: Under the bar, in one line: the sky (Cloudy, Rain...), sunrise, the chance of rain (always shown, even 0%) with the day's total, and sunset. The bar keeps the temperatures.

webApps.name: iSharpe CRM
webApps.description: Customers, visits, appointments and billing. Works offline once installed.

webApps.name: iSharpe Dashboard
webApps.description: The SystemCare dashboard: customers' computers, licenses and check-ins.
